The provided text aligns strongly with the post-apocalyptic and dystopian subgenres of science fiction and speculative fiction. Key thematic elements include the depiction of a ruined civilization ("barren wastelands," "former metropolis"), the rise of new power structures based on violence and scarcity ("warlords," "scavenger gangs"), and the archetype of the lone survivor or hero ("lone wanderer") seeking a mythical or literal sanctuary ("oasis"). The narrative emphasizes human resilience and hope amidst desolation, which are central tropes in this genre, serving to explore the fragility of society and the enduring nature of the human spirit.

The explorer who reached America in 1492 was Christopher Columbus.
